transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this pre-air lock meeting started. We've got the finale going live Saturday at 9 PM Eastern, and I need to finalize the voting package today so we can document everything before transmission. We've got standards, platform production, rights, and data protection all represented here. The current draft has viewers voting by SMS or through an online portal, open to our broadcast audience. Before I make the binding call on the final package, I want to hear from each of you — any concerns, constraints, or issues I should know about? Let's go around the room.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something from the network's current standards memo, which I issued after the draft voting rules were circulated. The memo establishes three binding requirements: voters must be at least 13 years old, each voter may cast exactly one vote per verified account, and voting must close at 9:50 PM Eastern. The draft voting package as currently written doesn't reflect these constraints, so they need to be incorporated into the final package before transmission.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue from platform certification. I completed the certification test this morning, and the SMS integration failed certification — only the web portal passed. The approved web portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted. This means the current draft's SMS voting option cannot be included in the final package for Saturday's transmission.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue on my end. I obtained the finalist label's written approval today, and it confirms that the voting interface may display finalist names and approved headshots, but it may NOT use any finalist performance audio or video. The draft voting interface as it currently stands still contains performance clips, so those need to be removed before the final package is locked.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a data protection issue. My privacy review, completed with the voting vendor this week, limits participation to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada, and requires voter identifiers to be deleted within 30 days. The current draft still describes worldwide participation and has no deletion step, so both of these need to be corrected in the final package before transmission.
